sentences.en: Many schools in the poor areas lack basic facilities.
sentences.zh: 许多贫困地区学校的基础设施很缺乏。

sentences.en: The government has launched programs to improve education in poor areas.
sentences.zh: 政府推出了计划来改善贫困地区的教育。

sentences.en: Volunteers often visit poor areas to help the local communities.
sentences.zh: 志愿者经常去贫困地区帮助当地社区。
